💡 لماذا يعكس سعر الذهب بالريال العماني ا: 💡 Why the gold price in Omani rials mirrors the global change exactly
الريال العماني مربوط رسمياً بالدولار الأ: The Omani rial has been officially pegged to the US dollar at a fixed rate since 1986: 1 Omani rial = 2.6008 US dollars. This means any change in the gold price here reflects directly the global change in dollars, with no extra effect from fluctuations in the local currency's exchange rate — unlike countries with floating currencies, which are affected by two factors at once (the gold price + the exchange rate).
عيار 24 هو الذهب الخالص، بينما الأعيرة ا: 24 karat is pure gold, while the lower karats (22, 21, 18) are alloyed with other metals for hardness and to withstand daily wear. When buying, compare the making charge between several shops (it varies a lot and sometimes affects the final price more than the gold price itself), always ask for an invoice stating the karat and the weight of the piece, and if your goal is investment, 24-karat bars and coins are better than jewelry because you do not lose the making charge when reselling.
